observations: Two blenders with clear sound enclosures (one black, one red) are displayed on top of boxes.
A product box on the left is branded 'STAR' with model 'ST-8002'.
The box describes the item as a 'High Speed Blender' with '2200W' and 'Quiet Design'.
The blenders feature a manual control panel with a central dial and two toggle switches.
The setting appears to be a retail shop with various other appliances like microwaves and air fryers visible.
The blender jars appear to be plastic with black lids.

photo 0 shows the units equipped with sound-dampening enclosures.
The jar capacity markings are not legible; 5L is significantly larger than the standard 2L-2.5L capacity for this model type.

risks.proof: A close-up photo of the underside of the jar and the motor's drive gear.

Photo of the measurement scale on the side of the blender jar.
Photo of the manufacturer's label/plate on the back or bottom of the machine.

response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the packaging in the photo. The item can be priced based on the STAR ST-8002 model, using the worst-case assumption that it is non-functional until proven otherwise.
